nvidia/nemotron-3.5-super-vl.author: NVIDIA
nvidia/nemotron-3.5-super-vl.disclosure: FIRST MEASUREMENT of NVIDIA Nemotron 3.5 Super VL on the text JevBench (the image benchmark is a separate lane), as a hosted API with no weights pin. REASONING DISABLED: reasoning.enabled=false, as required by the holder of the sealed items for this use; a reasoning-on configuration could score differently. SERVING: OpenRouter, provider Crusoe (bf16), provider order Crusoe only, fallbacks off; all 1,500 responses were checked for provider Crusoe and the exact model id. Strict json_schema output, temperature 0, max_tokens 4096, and the shared calibration system prompt (quoted in the measurement conditions). LATENCY: hosted-API latency from our server in Germany over OpenRouter (network round trip included): p50 0.63 s, p95 1.01 s, maximum 31.2 s; 56 HTTP 429 upstream rate-limit responses were re-sent and are not counted as answers. TOKENS: engine-reported usage, 1,015,566 input and 62,716 output tokens over all 1,500 decisions (no reasoning tokens). COST: the published OpenRouter tariff for this endpoint, USD 0.10 per million input tokens and USD 0.40 per million output tokens, counted from day 1 as a launch list price; no GPU-time estimate applies. DRAW: measured on the 27 Oct 2026 regular draw (fresh sealed items; not yet equated to the reference scale, so its numbers are shown as published, offset 0). This draw has no subject-topic labels yet, so the row has no topic cells; its use-case and language cells are measured on its own draw.
nvidia/nemotron-3.5-super-vl.endpoint_condition: Hosted API through OpenRouter, served by Crusoe (bf16): provider order Crusoe only, fallbacks off, bf16 quantization only. Every one of the 1,500 responses was checked for provider Crusoe and the exact model id nvidia/nemotron-3.5-super-vl. Reasoning disabled (reasoning.enabled=false). Strict json_schema output, temperature 0, max_tokens 4096, with the shared calibration system prompt: "You are a calibration engine. You never answer in prose. You output only a JSON object with the key 'probabilities' mapping every given option to a probability, all options included, values in [0,1], summing to 1." Latency is hosted-API latency measured from our server in Germany over OpenRouter (network round trip included): p50 0.63 s, p95 1.01 s, maximum 31.2 s; 2 decisions took longer than 10 s. 1,500 of 1,500 requests answered (HTTP 200). 56 upstream rate-limit responses (HTTP 429) were re-sent and are not counted as answers.
